Container.Name: CineVault
Container.Overview: CineVault (beta browser mode) scans your movie and TV folders, identifies the titles, writes NFO and artwork files in the Kodi, Jellyfin and Emby formats and renames folders and files with a preview and Undo. Open the WebUI, choose a password on the welcome page (open for 30 minutes after the container starts), then add your folders as /media/... in setup. Make the Secret key once in the Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -base64 32 and keep a copy.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port to open in the browser.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: CineVault's library, settings and password. Keep it on the cache or a local pool.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your movie and TV share, read-write (CineVault writes NFO and artwork and renames files). In CineVault's setup, add its folders under /media.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Encrypts your TMDB and other provider keys. Make it once with: openssl rand -base64 32 (base64 of 32 bytes). Without it, provider keys cannot be saved.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user that owns your media (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group that owns your media (100 = users on Unraid).
